gloss: to decline; to weaken; to deteriorate

definitions.explanation: When physical strength, health, or abilities diminish.
When power, influence, or prosperity decreases over time.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}ると、{体力|たいりょく}が{衰|おとろ}える。
examples.english: As you get older, your physical strength declines.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{視力|しりょく}が{衰|おとろ}えてきた。
examples.english: My grandfather's eyesight has been deteriorating.

examples.japanese: その{国|くに}の{勢力|せいりょく}は{次第|しだい}に{衰|おとろ}えていった。

notes:
{衰|おとろ}える is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). There is no common transitive pair.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{衰|おとろ}えている indicates an ongoing state of decline or weakness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {体力|たいりょく}が{衰|おとろ}える - physical strength declines
- {視力|しりょく}/{聴力|ちょうりょく}が{衰|おとろ}える - eyesight/hearing deteriorates
- {記憶力|きおくりょく}が{衰|おとろ}える - memory weakens
- {勢|いきお}いが{衰|おとろ}える - momentum/force wanes
- {衰|おとろ}え{知|し}らず - showing no signs of decline

RELATED WORDS:
- {衰弱|すいじゃく} - weakness, debility
- {衰退|すいたい} - decline, decay
